cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your invisible guest is welcome at our wedding. I'll reserve places for invisible companions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her family can walk through walls. They tend to wander.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll rent a ballroom that follows them. Nobody should miss cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our ballroom can split itself when guests wander apart.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll order a cake that multiplies with it. Every room deserves the first slice.
